---
title: "Making Videos Easier with AI: Generate and Edit with Just Text"
subtitle: "Discover how AI can create video clips from your words and let you edit them with simple text commands."
category: "explainer"
audience: "both"

Imagine needing a short video for a social media post, a family event, or a quick presentation, but you don't have the time or technical skills to shoot and edit it yourself. What if you could just type what you want, and an AI would do the hard work for you? That's exactly what AI video generation and text-based editing tools are beginning to offer.

## Creating Videos with Simple Text

At its core, AI video generation means you describe the video you want, and an AI model (the clever program behind it) attempts to create it for you. Think of it like a very advanced digital artist that specialises in moving pictures. Instead of sifting through stock footage or setting up a camera, you simply provide a text prompt (the instruction you type to the AI).

For example, you might type: "Create a short, positive video of a person smiling while drinking coffee in a sunlit cafe." The AI then processes this request, pulls together elements it understands from its training, and generates a video clip. Tools like Google Vids, featuring a powerful AI capability called Gemini Omni, are making this process more accessible, leading to higher-quality results with better realism and even improved text rendering (how clearly words appear within the video).

## Editing Videos by Typing What You Want

Beyond creating new clips, some AI tools are now letting you edit existing videos using natural language. This is a significant shift from traditional video editing software, which often requires learning complex interfaces and tools. With text-based editing, you can tell the AI exactly what you want to change, similar to how you might ask a human editor.

Here's how it generally works:

1.  **Upload Your Video:** You bring in a video you've already created or one that the AI has just generated for you.
2.  **Type Your Edits:** Instead of clicking through menus, you type commands. For instance, you could say:
    *   "Change the colour grading to give it a warmer, vintage feel." (Colour grading refers to adjusting the overall colour and tone of the video.)
    *   "Remove the background music and add a gentle, uplifting instrumental track."
    *   "Make the visual style of this scene more like an animated cartoon."
    *   "Trim the first five seconds and the last two seconds of the clip."
3.  **Review and Refine:** The AI will apply your requested changes, and you can then review the result. If it's not quite right, you can simply type another command to tweak it further.

This capability is still evolving, but the ability to simply "talk" to your video editor opens up a world of possibilities for creators of all skill levels.

## What This Means for You

This new era of AI-powered video tools is all about making creative tasks more accessible and efficient.

*   **In everyday life:** If you're a parent wanting to quickly compile a birthday video, a student needing to add a dynamic visual to a school project, or someone who loves sharing moments on social media, you can now create polished videos without needing expert-level software. Imagine generating a quick "Happy Anniversary" video or turning holiday photos into a dynamic montage with just a few typed sentences.
*   **For your business or work:** Marketing teams can rapidly prototype social media ads or explainer videos. Small business owners can create engaging content for their websites or customer communications without hiring a dedicated videographer. Even internal communications can become more dynamic by quickly generating short, engaging video updates from text.
*   **If you're just getting started:** The best way to understand this technology is to try it. Look for platforms that offer simple text-to-video generation or text-based editing. Start with a very simple prompt, like "Generate a five-second video of a cheerful dog playing fetch in a park," and see what the AI comes up with. Experimenting with basic commands will help you get a feel for its capabilities.

## Wrap-up

AI video generation and text-based editing are transforming how we create and modify visual content. By allowing you to simply describe what you want, these tools remove many of the technical barriers that once made video production daunting. This means more people can bring their creative ideas to life, whether for personal projects or professional needs. The next step is to find an accessible tool and start experimenting with your first text-to-video prompt today.
